# Yotpo API documentation

> All Yotpo APIs in one place: Yotpo API V3 (Core, Reviews storefront, Loyalty V3, privacy and webhooks), Loyalty API (V2), Reviews API (V1), the App partners API for apps that merchants install, and the legacy Core API V1. Categories in the sidebar are prefixed by group: "V3 ·", "Loyalty V2 ·", "Reviews V1 ·", "App partners ·" and "Core V1 ·".

Every link below is the Markdown version of a page. Endpoint entries start with the HTTP method and full URL; webhook events start with `WEBHOOK` and the event name.

## Key facts

- **Which API.** New store integrations (products, orders, customers, webhooks): Yotpo API V3. Showing reviews or loyalty points on a storefront: the V3 Reviews and Loyalty storefront endpoints. Loyalty programs (points, redemptions, referrals): Loyalty API (V2). Review moderation, exports, Q&A and Visual UGC: Reviews API (V1). An app many merchants install: App partners.
- **Base URLs.** V3 Core: `https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/...`. Reviews V1: `https://api.yotpo.com`. Public storefront reads: `https://api-cdn.yotpo.com` (reviews) and `https://storefront.yotpo.com/loyalty` (loyalty points). Loyalty V2: `https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/...`. App partners: `https://developers.yotpo.com`. Use HTTPS only.
- **Authentication.**
  - `api.yotpo.com` (V3, Reviews V1, Core V1): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/access_tokens` with `{"secret": "<API secret>"}` returns `access_token`. Send it in the `X-Yotpo-Token` header. The same token works for V1 calls. Exceptions: Reviews Insights takes `Authorization: Bearer`.
  - Storefront endpoints need no token.
  - Loyalty V2: your Loyalty GUID and API key in the `x-guid` and `x-api-key` headers.
  - App partners: a per-store token from the OAuth 2.0 install flow, sent in `X-Yotpo-Token`.
- **Pagination.** V3: `limit` (1 to 100, default 100) and `page_info`; pass `pagination.next_page_info` as `page_info`. Older APIs use `page` and `count` or their own cursors, shown on each endpoint.
- **Errors.** Status codes and bodies differ by host; see https://docs.yotpo.com/docs/error-handling.md. There's no sandbox; see https://docs.yotpo.com/docs/testing-your-integration.md.
- **Rate limits.** `api.yotpo.com`: 5 requests per second per store, shared by every integration on that store. App partners and Loyalty V2 have their own limits, listed in their guidelines. A `429` carries `Retry-After` (seconds).
- **Webhooks.** Create a target (your HTTPS URL), a filter (event names) and a subscription. Every event name and payload: https://docs.yotpo.com/docs/topics.md.
- **Privacy requests.** Reviews and Loyalty each have their own check, export and delete endpoints; see https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/about-privacy-api.md.

## API reference · V3 · Getting Started

- [Welcome](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/welcome.md): Everything you need before your first Core API call.
- [About authentication](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/authentication.md): One access token authenticates every Yotpo API on api.yotpo.com: V3, Reviews V1 and Core V1. Generate it with your store ID and API secret, then send it in the X-Yotpo-Token header.
- [Generate Access Token](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/yotpo-authentication.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/access_tokens` This endpoint uses your Yotpo Store ID (app_key) and API secret to generate the API access token necessary to authenticate most of Yotpo's API calls.

## API reference · V3 · Orders & Fulfillments

- [About orders](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/orders.md): Sync your store orders to Yotpo.
- [Create order](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-order.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/orders` Creates an order in your Yotpo store. This triggers review requests only, once the order has a fulfillment. To award loyalty points, also send the order to Loyalty Create Order.
- [Update order](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/update-order.md): `PATCH https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/orders/{yotpo_order_id}` Updates an order in your Yotpo store.
- [Retrieve orders](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-orders.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/orders` Retrieves a list of orders for your Yotpo store.
- [Retrieve order by ID](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-order-by-id.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/orders/{yotpo_order_id}` Retrieves all of the details of a specific order using its Yotpo ID.
- [About order fulfillments](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/order-fulfillments.md): Sync your store order fulfillments to Yotpo. Order fulfillments represent a group of one or more items in an order that are to be fulfilled from the same location.
- [Create order fulfillment](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-order-fulfillment.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/orders/{yotpo_order_id}/fulfillments` Creates an order fulfillment in your Yotpo store.
- [Update order fulfillment](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/update-order-fulfillment.md): `PATCH https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/orders/{yotpo_order_id}/fulfillments/{yotpo_fulfillment_id}` Updates an order fulfillment in your Yotpo store.
- [Retrieve order fulfillments](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-order-fulfillments.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/orders/{yotpo_order_id}/fulfillments` Retrieves a list of fulfillments for an order in your Yotpo store.
- [Retrieve fulfillment by ID](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-fulfillment-by-id.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/orders/{yotpo_order_id}/fulfillments/{yotpo_fulfillment_id}` Retrieves all fulfillments for a specific order using its Yotpo ID.
- [About aggregated order info](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/aggregated-order-info.md): In order to send Yotpo all relevant information regarding the order in one batch, you can use the Register purchase endpoint.
- [Send aggregated order info](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/send-aggregated-order-info.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/register_purchase` Sends all relevant order information to Yotpo in one batch.

## API reference · V3 · Products & Collections

- [About products](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/products.md): The Product entity allows you to keep your catalog in-sync with Yotpo.
- [Create product](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-product.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/products` Creates a new product within your product catalog.
- [Update product](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/update-product.md): `PATCH https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/products/{yotpo_product_id}` Update the product information in Yotpo.
- [Retrieve products](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-products.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/products` Retrieves a list of all of your store's products. You can use this endpoint to resolve the Yotpo product ID in order to update it.
- [Retrieve product by ID](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-product-by-id.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/products/{yotpo_product_id}` Retrieves all product information for a specific product using its Yotpo ID.
- [About product variants](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/product-variants.md): Sync your product variants to Yotpo. Add variants to your products in order to represent one version of a product with several options, for example, size, or color.
- [Create product variant](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-product-variant.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/products/{yotpo_product_id}/variants` Creates a new product variant within your product catalog.
- [Update product variant](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/update-product-variant.md): `PATCH https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/products/{yotpo_product_id}/variants/{yotpo_variant_id}` Updates a product variant within your product catalog.
- [Retrieve product variants](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-product-variants.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/products/{yotpo_product_id}/variants` Retrieves a list of product variants within your product catalog.
- [Retrieve product variant by ID](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-product-variant-by-id.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/products/{yotpo_product_id}/variants/{yotpo_variant_id}` Retrieves a product variant by store ID, product ID, and product variant ID.
- [About collections](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/collections.md): Sync your product collections to Yotpo. A collection is a grouping of products that you can use to make your store easier to browse.
- [Create collection](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-collection.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/collections` Creates a new collection within your product catalog.
- [Update collection](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/update-collection.md): `PATCH https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/collections/{yotpo_collection_id}` Updates a collection within your product catalog.
- [Retrieve collections](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-collections.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/collections` Retrieves a list of all of your store's collections.
- [Add product to collection](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/add-product-to-collection.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/collections/{yotpo_collection_id}/products` Adds a product to a collection within your product catalog.
- [Retrieve products in collection](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-products-in-collection.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/collections/{yotpo_collection_id}/products` Retrieves a paginated list of products from a collection in your product catalog.
- [Remove product from collection](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/remove-product-from-collection.md): `DELETE https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/collections/{yotpo_collection_id}/products` Removes a product from a collection within your product catalog.
- [Retrieve list of collections for product](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-list-of-collections-for-product.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/products/{yotpo_product_id}/collections` Retrieves a paginated list of collections within your product catalog that a product belongs to.

## API reference · V3 · Customers

- [About customers](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/customers.md): Sync your store customers to Yotpo, to be used as contacts for messaging.
- [Create or update customer](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-customer.md): `PATCH https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/customers` Creates a customer in your Yotpo store.
- [Retrieve customers](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-customers.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/customers` Retrieves a list of past and existing customers from your Yotpo store. Use this endpoint to check if a customer was registered successfully with Yotpo.
- [List Customer Segments](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/list-customer-segments.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/profile_groups` Returns the store's customer segments and imported lists, with each segment's rules, type and data sources.
- [Get a Customer Segment](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/get-customer-segment.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/profile_groups/{profile_group_id}` Returns one customer segment by ID, with its rules and its size.

## API reference · V3 · Reviews

- [Retrieve product reviews](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-product-reviews.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/store/{storeId}/product/{productId}/reviews` Retrieves storefront reviews for a specific product.
- [Search product reviews](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-product-reviews-search.md): `POST https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/store/{storeId}/product/{productId}/reviews` Search or filter storefront reviews for a specific product.
- [Retrieve product filters](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-product-filters.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/store/{storeId}/product/{productId}/productFilters` Retrieves product-level filters used for storefront review experiences.
- [Retrieve product data](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-product-data.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/stores/{storeId}/products/{productId}/productData` Retrieves product-level data used for storefront review experiences.
- [Retrieve reviews media](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-reviews-media.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/stores/{storeId}/products/{productId}/reviewsMedia` Retrieve media assets associated with product reviews.
- [Retrieve top product reviews](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-top-reviews.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/store/{storeId}/product/{productId}/top_reviews` Retrieves top reviews for a product.
- [Retrieve top store reviews](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-store-top-reviews.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/store/{storeId}/top_reviews` Retrieves top reviews for a store.
- [Retrieve store reviews](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-store-reviews.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/store/{storeId}/reviews` Retrieves every review in the store, across all products, one page at a time. Review objects here use snake_case field names (`votes_up`, `created_at`), unlike the product reviews endpoint.
- [Search store reviews](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-store-reviews-search.md): `POST https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/store/{storeId}/reviews` Search or filter storefront reviews for a specific store.
- [Retrieve bottomline scores](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-all-bottomlines.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/stores/{storeId}/ratings` Retrieve bottomline scores for each product in a store.
- [Retrieve product rating bottomline](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-product-ratings.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/store/{storeId}/product/{productId}/ratings` Retrieves rating bottomline information for a specific product. The same data is also served at `/v3/storefront/stores/{storeId}/products/{productId}/ratings`.
- [Retrieve promoted products for a store](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-store-promoted-products.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/store/{storeId}/promoted_products` Returns the products the store promotes in the Promoted Products widget, in display order. No access token is needed. Data is cached on Yotpo's CDN, so changes can take time to appear.
- [Retrieve promoted products for a product page](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-product-promoted-products.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/store/{storeId}/product/{productId}/promoted_products` Returns the products to promote on a given product page, in display order. An unknown product ID returns the store-level list. No access token is needed. Data is cached on Yotpo's CDN, so changes can take time to appear.
- [Retrieve gallery media](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-gallery-media.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/stores/{storeId}/widget_instance_id/{widgetInstanceId}/sorted_media` Returns the media in a Visual UGC gallery, in the order the merchant set. Send `source_album_id` for a custom gallery, or `external_product_id` for a product gallery. No access token is needed.
- [Retrieve a gallery media item](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-gallery-media-item.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v3/storefront/stores/{storeId}/album_media/{albumMediaId}` Returns one media item from a Visual UGC gallery, with its caption, author and votes. Get the `albumMediaId` from Retrieve gallery media. No access token is needed.
- [Retrieve AI review summary](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/reviews-ai-summary.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/reviews/v3/stores/{storeId}/products/{productId}/reviews_summary` Returns the AI-written summary of a product's reviews: a one-paragraph summary, a summary per topic, and supporting quotes. Needs an access token.
- [List Syndicated Retailers](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/list-syndicated-retailers.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/v3/stores/{store_id}/retailer-syndication/syndicated-accounts` Returns the retailers the store's reviews are syndicated to, with each one's opt-in status and start date.

## API reference · V3 · Loyalty

- [Product Potential Points](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/get-product-potential-points.md): `POST https://storefront.yotpo.com/loyalty/v3/stores/{store_id}/product_potential_points` Calculates the potential points a customer can earn for a product and its variants. Does not require customer authentication. Returns points based on general earning rules.
- [Authenticated Product Potential Points](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/get-customer-product-potential-points.md): `POST https://storefront.yotpo.com/loyalty/v3/stores/{store_id}/customer_product_potential_points` Calculates the potential points an authenticated customer can earn for a product and its variants. Requires customer authentication headers. Includes customer-specific multipliers (e.g.
- [Get product potential earnings](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/get-product-potential-earnings.md): `GET https://storefront.yotpo.com/loyalty/v3/stores/{store_id}/product_potential_earnings` Returns how many points a shopper would earn by buying a product at a given price, for "Earn X points" messages on product pages. No shopper login or access token is needed.
- [Get customer product potential earnings](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/get-customer-product-potential-earnings.md): `GET https://storefront.yotpo.com/loyalty/v3/stores/{store_id}/customer_product_potential_earnings` Returns how many points a logged-in shopper would earn by buying a product at a given price, with their VIP tier multiplier applied. Authenticate the shopper with the three `X-Customer` headers.
- [Retrieve referral programs](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-referral-programs.md): `GET https://storefront.yotpo.com/loyalty/v3/stores/{store_id}/referrals/programs` Returns the store's referral programs: rewards for the friend and the advocate, landing pages and validation rules. The referral widgets use it. No access token is needed.
- [Retrieve the Spotlight view for a shopper](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-widget-spotlight.md): `GET https://storefront.yotpo.com/loyalty/v3/stores/{store_id}/customer_view/{view}` Returns everything the Spotlight widget shows a logged-in shopper: points balance and value, VIP tier, unused rewards, and the store settings that control discount stacking and free products.
- [List free-product rewards for a shopper](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-widget-customer-free-products.md): `GET https://storefront.yotpo.com/loyalty/v3/stores/{store_id}/customer_free_products` Lists the store's free-product rewards grouped by product, with each variant's points cost, stock and VIP tier restriction. Spotlight uses it for its variant picker.
- [Get VIP Tiers Program](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/get-vip-tiers-program.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/loyalty/v3/stores/{store_id}/vip_tiers/programs/current` Returns the store's current VIP tiers program: its general settings and every tier with its criteria, rewards, and benefits.
- [Get VIP Tiers Program Status](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/get-vip-tiers-program-status.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/loyalty/v3/stores/{store_id}/vip_tiers/programs/current:status` Returns the status of the store's current VIP tiers program. Check that the program is ACTIVE before pushing customers to a tier.
- [Push Customer to Tier](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/push-customer-to-tier.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/loyalty/v3/stores/{store_id}/vip_tiers/customers/{customer_id}:push_to_tier` Manually assigns a customer to a VIP tier, either until a set end date or indefinitely.
- [Reward Instances API](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-reward-instances.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/v3/stores/{store_id}/reward_instances` The Reward Instances API allows merchants to retrieve details of coupon-based rewards issued to their customers. This API supports querying reward instances based on discount type, expiration, and usage status.
- [List Points Campaigns](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/list-points-campaigns.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/loyalty/v3/stores/{store_id}/campaigns` Returns the store's points drops and points multiplier campaigns, with their status, dates and audience import progress.
- [Get a Points Campaign](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/get-points-campaign.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/loyalty/v3/stores/{store_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}` Returns one points drop or points multiplier campaign by ID, including audience import progress and failure details.

## API reference · V3 · Privacy

- [About Privacy API](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/about-privacy-api.md): Check for, retrieve and delete a shopper's personal data in Yotpo, for data subject requests such as GDPR and CCPA.
- [Data exists](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/data-exists.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/privacy/data/exists` A synchronous request that checks for existing account data (true/false) in the Yotpo system.
- [User data](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/fetch-user-data.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/privacy/data` An asynchronous request that retrieves existing user data in the Yotpo system. User data is sent as a JSON file to the account email address associated with your Yotpo account.
- [GDPR Delete](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/gdpr-delete.md): `DELETE https://api.yotpo.com/privacy/data` Deletes or anonymizes end-user data for given email address(es). Supports multiple emails per batch; requests are handled asynchronously.

## API reference · V3 · Webhooks & Events

- [Create target](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-target.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/targets` Creates a webhook target or callback URL for listening to events. The webhook target can be used to listen to multiple events from multiple accounts.
- [Retrieve targets](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-targets.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/targets` Retrieves a list of all of your webhook targets.
- [Retrieve target by ID](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-target-by-id.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/targets/{yotpo_target_id}` Retrieves a webhook target using its Yotpo ID.
- [Update target](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/update-target.md): `PATCH https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/targets/{yotpo_target_id}` Updates a webhook target. This webhook target can be used for listening to multiple events from multiple accounts.
- [Delete target](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/delete-target.md): `DELETE https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/targets/{yotpo_target_id}` Deletes a webhook target. This webhook target can be used for listening to multiple events from multiple accounts, and so only unused webhook targets can be deleted.
- [Create filter](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-filter.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/filters` Create a webhook filter. This webhook filter can be used with multiple webhook targets. An event type cannot be used twice in the same webhook filter. For every event name you can subscribe to, see Webhook events.
- [Retrieve filters](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-filters.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/filters` Retrieves a list of all of your webhook filters.
- [Retrieve filter by ID](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-filter-by-id.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/filters/{yotpo_filter_id}` Retrieves a webhook filter using its Yotpo ID.
- [Update filter](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/update-filter.md): `PATCH https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/filters/{yotpo_filter_id}` Updates a webhook filter. This webhook filter can be used with multiple webhook targets.
- [Delete filter](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/delete-filter.md): `DELETE https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/filters/{yotpo_filter_id}` Deletes a webhook filter. This webhook filter can be used with multiple webhook targets, so only unused webhook filters can be deleted.
- [Create subscription](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-subscription.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/subscriptions` Combine the target and filter to create a subscription.
- [Retrieve subscriptions](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-subscriptions.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/subscriptions` Retrieves a list of all of your webhook subscriptions.
- [Retrieve subscription by ID](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-subscription-by-id.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/subscriptions/{yotpo_subscription_id}` Retrieves a webhook subscription using its Yotpo ID.
- [Update subscription](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/update-subscription.md): `PATCH https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/subscriptions/{yotpo_subscription_id}` Updates a webhook subscription.
- [Delete subscription](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/delete-subscription.md): `DELETE https://api.yotpo.com/core/v3/stores/{store_id}/webhooks/subscriptions/{yotpo_subscription_id}` Deletes a webhook subscription.

## API reference · V3 · Review Events

- [Review Created](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/review-create.md): `WEBHOOK review_create` Sent when a new review is created. To receive it, add `review_create` to `events` when you create a filter, then subscribe the filter to your target.
- [Review Updated](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/review-updated.md): `WEBHOOK review_updated` Sent when: - A review is published. - A review is unpublished (rejected). - A reviewer verifies their email (for reviews written in the PDP Reviews Widget), and the review changes from anonymous to *verified reviewer*.
- [Review Request Eligible on Fulfillment](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/review-request-eligible-on-fulfillment.md): `WEBHOOK review_request.eligible.on_fulfillment` Sent when an order becomes eligible for a review request after it is fulfilled. Use it to send review requests from your own messaging platform.
- [Review Request Eligible on Delivery](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/review-request-eligible-on-delivery.md): `WEBHOOK review_request.eligible.on_delivery` Sent when an order becomes eligible for a review request after it is delivered. Use it to send review requests from your own messaging platform.

## API reference · V3 · Loyalty Events

- [Coupon Earned](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-redemption-created.md): `WEBHOOK swell/redemption/created` Sent when a customer gets a coupon code, either by completing a campaign (for example a newsletter signup) or by redeeming points. Use it to email the coupon code to the customer.
- [Custom Reward Redeemed](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-custom-reward-created.md): `WEBHOOK loyalty/custom/reward/created` Sent when a customer redeems points for a custom reward, or gets a custom reward for completing a campaign.
- [Customer Birthday](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-customer-birthday.md): `WEBHOOK swell/customer/birthday` Sent on a customer's birthday. Use it to send a birthday email and tell the customer about any points or coupon from your Birthday campaign.
- [Customer Birthday Captured](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-birthday-captured.md): `WEBHOOK swell/birthday/captured` Sent when a customer sets their birthday on your storefront, or when it's updated in Yotpo Loyalty.
- [Customer Anniversary](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-customer-anniversary.md): `WEBHOOK swell/customer/anniversary` Sent on a customer's anniversary. Use it to send an anniversary email and tell the customer about any points or coupon from your Anniversary campaign.
- [Customer Anniversary Captured](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-anniversary-captured.md): `WEBHOOK swell/anniversary/captured` Sent when a customer sets their anniversary on your storefront. To receive it, add `swell/anniversary/captured` to `events` when you create a filter, then subscribe the filter to your target.
- [Donation Created](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-donation-created.md): `WEBHOOK loyalty/donation/created` Sent when a customer redeems points for a donation to a nonprofit through the Shopping Gives integration.
- [Account Created](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-account-created.md): `WEBHOOK swell/account/created` Sent when a customer gets the reward for the New Member Reward earning rule. Use it to send a loyalty welcome email.
- [Loyalty Opt In](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-opt-in.md): `WEBHOOK loyalty/opt_in` Sent when a customer opts in to the loyalty program. Opted-in customers can earn and redeem points and join tiers.
- [Loyalty Opt Out](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-opt-out.md): `WEBHOOK loyalty/opt_out` Sent when a customer opts out of the loyalty program. Opted-out customers can't take part in any loyalty activity.
- [Points Changed](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-points-changed.md): `WEBHOOK swell/points/changed` Sent every time a customer's points balance changes, with the balance before and after. Use it to keep a points balance in another system in sync.
- [Points Earned](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-points-earned.md): `WEBHOOK swell/points/earned` Sent when a customer earns points. Use it to keep the customer's points balance up to date in your CRM or email platform.
- [Points Reminder](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-points-reminder.md): `WEBHOOK swell/points/reminder` Sent after a set number of days of inactivity, when the customer is close to earning a reward. Use it to remind them.
- [Points Expiration Reminder](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-expiration-reminder.md): `WEBHOOK loyalty/expiration/reminder` Sent when a customer's points are about to expire. Use it to remind them to use their points.
- [Redemption Below Threshold](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-redemption-code-below-threshold.md): `WEBHOOK swell/redemption_code/below_threshold` Sent when a Custom Coupon reward is running low on uploaded codes: when the unused codes reach the reward's threshold, then half, a quarter and an eighth of it, and 0.
- [Redemption Cancellation Request](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-point-redemption-cancellation-request.md): `WEBHOOK swell/point_redemption/cancellation_request` Sent when a customer asks to cancel a redemption and get their points back. The points are returned only after you approve the cancellation through the API.
- [Redemption Reminder](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-redemption-reminder.md): `WEBHOOK swell/redemption/reminder` Sent after a set number of days of inactivity, when the customer has enough points for a reward. Use it to remind them.
- [Referral Link Share](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-referral-share.md): `WEBHOOK swell/referral/share` Sent when a customer shares their referral link with friends. Use it to tell the friend that someone they know likes your store.
- [Referral Link Share (2.0)](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/yotpo-referral-shared.md): `WEBHOOK yotpo/referral/shared` Sent when a customer shares their referral link with friends. Use it to tell the friend that someone they know likes your store.
- [Referral Share Reminder](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-referral-share-reminder.md): `WEBHOOK swell/referral/share/reminder` Sent when a referred friend hasn't made a purchase after a set number of days. Use it to remind them to use the referral link, so both customers get a reward.
- [Referral Product Share Link](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-referral-product-share.md): `WEBHOOK loyalty/referral/product_share` Sent when a customer shares a product referral link. Use it to send the product share email from your own email platform.
- [Referral Product Share Reminder](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-referral-product-share-reminder.md): `WEBHOOK loyalty/referral/product_share/reminder` Sent when a referred friend hasn't made a purchase after a set number of days. Use it to remind them to use the product referral link, so both customers get a reward.
- [Referral Completed](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-referral-completed.md): `WEBHOOK swell/referral/completed` Sent when a customer refers a friend who meets your referral program's requirements. Use it to thank the customer for the referral.
- [Referral Completed (2.0)](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/yotpo-referral-completed.md): `WEBHOOK yotpo/referral/completed` Sent when a customer refers a friend who meets your referral program's requirements. Use it to thank the customer for the referral.
- [Tier Earned](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-tier-earned.md): `WEBHOOK swell/tier/earned` Sent when a customer meets the requirements for a new tier. Use it to congratulate them on their new status.
- [Tier Lost](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-tier-lost.md): `WEBHOOK swell/tier/lost` Sent when a customer no longer meets the requirements for their tier at the end of the period, or when they opt out of the loyalty program.
- [Tier Status Changed](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/swell-tier-status-changed.md): `WEBHOOK swell/tier/status/changed` Sent when a customer gets closer to or farther from keeping their current tier or reaching the next one.
- [Tier Expiration Reminder](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/yotpo-tier-expiration-reminder.md): `WEBHOOK yotpo/tier/expiration/reminder` Sent when a customer is at risk of losing their tier: 30, 14 and 7 days before it expires, depending on your settings, and only if they haven't met the requirements to keep it. Each reminder is sent once.
- [CommerceCloud Integration Disabled](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-integrations-integration-disabled.md): `WEBHOOK loyalty/integrations/integration_disabled` Sent when the Salesforce Commerce Cloud integration is disabled because of authorization errors.

## API reference · Loyalty V2 · General

- [Welcome](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-welcome.md): Everything you need before your first Loyalty API call.
- [What you can build](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/what-you-can-build.md): Pick what you want to build and follow the path. Each one starts with a recipe or a single call and links to the reference pages you need next.
- [Authentication](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-authentication.md): How to authenticate with the Yotpo Loyalty API using your GUID and API key.
- [Guidelines & Conventions](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-guidelines-and-conventions.md): Rate limits, errors, testing and usage conventions for the Yotpo Loyalty & Referrals API.
- [Errors](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/errors.md): The status codes the Loyalty API returns, the error bodies each part of the API sends, and how to handle each one.
- [Testing your integration](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/testing-your-integration.md): There's no sandbox, so every call reaches a real Loyalty program. How to test without changing real customers' points, sending emails or issuing live coupons.

## API reference · Loyalty V2 · Customers

- [Customers](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-customers.md): Create customer records and read or update a customer's loyalty data: point balance, referral link, birthday, anniversary and tags.
- [Create/Update Customer Record](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-update-customer-records.md): `POST https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/customers` This endpoint both creates and updates a customer’s record in the Yotpo system. Use this primarily to notify Yotpo when you add a customer manually in your admin, or a customer changes their email address.
- [Set Customer Birthday](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/set-customer-birthday.md): `POST https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/customer_birthdays` Stores the customer's birthday, which birthday campaigns use to award points or rewards on the customer's birthday. day and month are required; year is optional. Calling again overwrites the stored birthday.
- [Set/Update Customer Anniversary](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-update-customer-anniversary.md): `POST https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/customer_anniversary` Stores or updates the customer's anniversary date — any date meaningful to your program (signup, first purchase, or a customer-provided date). Used by anniversary campaigns the way birthdays power birthday campaigns.
- [Get Customer Anniversary](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/get-customer-anniversary.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/customer_anniversary` Retrieves the customer's stored anniversary date, if one has been set. Pass an optional `campaign_id` to get the anniversary data as resolved for a specific anniversary campaign.
- [Remove Customer Anniversary](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/remove-customer-anniversary.md): `DELETE https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/customer_anniversary` Deletes the customer's stored anniversary. After removal, the customer no longer triggers anniversary-based campaigns.
- [Fetch Customer Details](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/fetch-customer-details.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/customers` This endpoint returns a customer record. Most commonly used to fetch a customer’s point balance and unique referral link.
- [Fetch All Recently Updated Customers](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/fetch-all-recently-updated-customers.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/customers/recent` Fetches a list of all the customers who were updated in the last 7 days, and their customer data registered in the Yotpo Loyalty database
- [Get Customer Tags](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/get-customer-tags.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/customer_tags` Retrieves the list of tags currently assigned to a customer.
- [Add Customer Tags](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/add-customer-tags.md): `PUT https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/customer_tags/add` Adds one or more tags to a customer. Duplicate tags (case-insensitive) are ignored.
- [Remove Customer Tags](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/remove-customer-tags.md): `PUT https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/customer_tags/remove` Removes one or more tags from a customer. Matching is case-insensitive.

## API reference · Loyalty V2 · Actions

- [Actions](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-actions.md): Award points for things customers do outside an order, and correct point balances by hand.
- [Record a Custom Action](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/record-a-customer-action.md): `POST https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/actions` This endpoint records an action performed by a customer. It will apply the action to all active custom action campaigns and award the necessary points and/or discounts.
- [Adjust a Customer's Point Balance](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/adjust-a-customers-point-balance.md): `POST https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/points/adjust` Adds or removes points from a customer's balance outside of normal campaign earning — for goodwill credits, support resolutions, or corrections. The adjustment appears in the customer's points history.
- [Remove a Customer from an Action Based VIP Tier](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/removing-a-customer-from-an-action-based-vip-tier.md): `PUT https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/actions/cancel_all` Use this endpoint to revoke a customer's action based VIP tier status

## API reference · Loyalty V2 · Orders

- [Orders](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-orders.md): Send orders so customers earn points.
- [Create Order](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-create-order.md): `POST https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/orders` This endpoint records an order made by a customer. It will apply the order to all matching active campaigns and award the necessary points and/or discounts. This awards loyalty points only.

## API reference · Loyalty V2 · Refunds

- [Refunds](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-refunds.md): Adjust an order you already sent, so points earned on refunded items are taken back.
- [Create Refund](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-refund.md): `POST https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/refunds` Send a new refund to the Yotpo API to adjust previously processed order. Requests are processed asynchronously.

## API reference · Loyalty V2 · Campaigns

- [Campaigns](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-campaigns.md): List the campaigns customers can take part in.
- [Get Active Campaigns](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/get-active-campaigns.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/campaigns` This endpoint returns a list of campaigns available for customers to participate in. If you provide a particular customer we can return their current status and eligibility on each of the campaigns.

## API reference · Loyalty V2 · Redemption Options

- [Redemption Options](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-redemption-options.md): Read the rewards customers can redeem points for, and manage the coupon codes behind them.
- [Upload Coupon Codes](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/add-coupon-codes.md): `POST https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/redemption_codes` Uploads up to 10,000 coupon codes to a coupon-type redemption option's pool. Codes are handed out one per redemption as customers redeem the option — keep the pool topped up so redemptions never fail for lack of codes.
- [Get Active Redemption Options](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/fetch-active-redemption-options.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/redemption_options` This endpoint returns a list of redemption options available for customers to redeem.
- [Get Redemption Code Data](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/get-redemption-code-data.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/redemption_codes` This endpoint lets you fetch the email address of a customer who redeemed a discount by providing a `third party_id` or the discount `code`.

## API reference · Loyalty V2 · Point Redemptions

- [Point Redemptions](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-point-redemptions.md): Spend a customer's points on a reward, and return points when a redemption is cancelled.
- [Create Redemption](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-redemption.md): `POST https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/redemptions` This endpoint will redeem a customer’s points for a particular redemption option.
- [Approve Redemption Cancellation](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/approve-redemption-cancellation.md): `POST https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/redemptions/{point_redemption_id}/cancellation_completed` This endpoint will confirm the Redemption Cancellation Request webhook so that the customer will receive their points from redemption back into their account.

## API reference · Loyalty V2 · Referrals

- [Referrals](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-referrals.md): Get a customer's referral link and send referral invitations for them.
- [Identify Referrer](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/identify-referrer.md): `POST https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/referral/referrer` Finds or creates the customer as a referrer and returns their referral link along with their referral history — referral_receipts lists past sign-ups and completed referrals.
- [Send Referral Emails](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/send-referral-emails.md): `POST https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/referral/share` Sends referral invitations to a comma-separated list of addresses on the referrer's behalf.

## API reference · Loyalty V2 · VIP Tiers

- [VIP Tiers](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-vip-tiers.md): Read your program's VIP tiers.
- [Fetch VIP Tiers](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/fetch-vip-tiers.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/vip_tiers` Returns your program's configured VIP tiers, including each tier's ID — use it to display tier structure to customers or to look up the tier IDs other endpoints reference.

## API reference · Loyalty V2 · Privacy

- [Data exists (Loyalty)](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-data-exists.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/privacy/data/exists` A synchronous request that checks for existing account data (true/false) in the Yotpo loyalty system.
- [User data (Loyalty)](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-user-data.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/privacy/data` An asynchronous request that retrieves existing user data in the Yotpo loyalty system. User data is sent as a JSON file to the account email address associated with the Yotpo loyalty account.
- [Anonymize user (Loyalty)](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-anonymize-user.md): `DELETE https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/v2/privacy/data` As part of Global Data Regulation compliance, this endpoint removes and anonymizes end-user personal information collected by Yotpo. To learn more, click here.

## API reference · Loyalty V1 · Storefront

- [Retrieve public store settings](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-widget-merchant.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/public/v1/merchants/{guid}` Returns the public settings the Loyalty widgets need to render: the store name, its account login and registration URLs, the Facebook app ID for sharing, and the store currency. No authentication.
- [List currency exchange rates](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-widget-merchant-currencies.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/public/v1/merchant_currencies` Lists the currencies set up for multi-currency in Loyalty, each with the exchange rate the widgets use to convert reward values from the store's main currency. No authentication.
- [List rewards (storefront)](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-storefront-redemption-options.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/public/v1/redemption_options` Returns the rewards shoppers can redeem points for, for a rewards page or a redemption widget. It needs only your public Loyalty GUID, so you can call it from the browser.
- [List VIP tiers (storefront)](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-storefront-vip-tiers.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/public/v1/tiers` Returns your VIP tiers, lowest first, with what a shopper must do to enter, keep and regain each one. It needs only your public Loyalty GUID, so you can call it from the browser.
- [List ways to earn (storefront)](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/loyalty-storefront-campaigns.md): `GET https://loyalty.yotpo.com/api/public/v1/campaigns` Returns your live earning campaigns, for a "ways to earn" section. It needs only your public Loyalty GUID, so you can call it from the browser.

## API reference · Reviews V1 · General

- [Welcome](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/reviews-welcome.md): Introduction to the Yotpo UGC API: access reviews, photos, insights, and more.

## API reference · Reviews V1 · Reviews - Merchant

- [About reviews (merchant)](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/about-merchant-reviews.md): Reviews are the core content generated using Yotpo. Yotpo helps generate reviews that can later be displayed on the store's site and published on social networks.
- [Create review](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-review.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/v1/widget/reviews` This is the asynchronous method and is recommended for general use.
- [Create review (synchronous)](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/create-review-synchronous.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/reviews/dynamic_create` Note: This method is recommended for development only.
- [Upload Images With Reviews Via API](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/upload-images-with-reviews.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/images/process` Upload images to associate with a review using the image_upload_token received from the Create Reviews endpoint.
- [Retrieve a review by review ID](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-a-review-by-review-id.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/reviews/{review_id}` Retrieves a single review by its `review_id`.
- [Retrieve reviews for a user using external user reference ID](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-reviews-for-a-specific-user.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/products/{store_id}/yotpo_global_reviews/reviews.json` This endpoint requires a Yotpo premium plan.
- [About SEO](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/about-seo.md): Rich snippets are extra pieces of information which are shown within Google search results to provide more information to the person running the search.
- [Find if your yotpo.me Subdomain is available](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/find-if-the-xxxxyotpome-subdomain-is-valid.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/apps/{store_id}/subomain_check/{subdomain}` The path segment is spelled `subomain_check`. This is the real route; `subdomain_check` returns `404`.
- [Retrieve your reviews.me URL](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-your-reviewsme-url.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/v1/reviews_me/url/{store_id}/{product_id}` Reviews.me generates SEO friendly pages to be used in various SEO features, such as Rich Snippets

## API reference · Reviews V1 · Reviews - Storefront

- [About reviews (storefront)](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/about-storefront-reviews.md): Reviews are the core content generated using Yotpo. Yotpo helps generate reviews that can later be displayed on the store's site and published on social networks.
- [Top Three 5-Star Reviews](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/recent-5-star-reviews.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/apps/{store_id}/top_reviews` Retrieve the top three 5-star reviews per account. This endpoint will return the top three 5-star reviews (including unpublished reviews) based on Yotpo's smart algorithm in JSON or HTML format.
- [Retrieve the reviews payload in HTML](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-the-reviews-payload-in-html.md): The methods parameter is an array of methods. Each method is a hash containing the method and parameters, which is an hash of the parameters for the method.
- [Upvote or downvote reviews](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/vote-on-reviews.md): `POST https://api.yotpo.com/reviews/{review_id}/vote/{vote_type}` Vote up or down on whether a particular review is helpful by `review_id`.
- [Top mentioned topics](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/top-mentioned-topics.md): `POST https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v1/topic/{store_id}/topics.json` Retrieves top mentioned topics for a given product by product ID (`domain_key`). These topics are displayed as smart filters within your reviews widget.
- [Retrieve LLM schema HTML for a product](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-llm-schema.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v1/stores/{store_id}/products/{product_id}/llm-schema` Retrieve a product's user-generated content as an HTML snippet, built for server-side embedding on Product Detail Pages so LLM crawlers can index review content from the page source.
- [Retrieve star distribution for a product](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/storefront-star-distribution.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v1/star_distribution/store/{storeId}/product/{productId}` Returns how many published reviews a product has at each star rating, from 1 to 5. The V3 reviews widget uses it for its rating breakdown. An unknown product ID returns zeros. No access token is needed.

## API reference · Reviews V1 · Reviews Metadata

- [About reviews metadata](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/about-reviews-metadata.md): Leverage metadata collected upon order creation to allow shoppers to filter reviews according to customer, order, and/or product-related fields such as membership type, location, delivery type, order history, and more!
- [Retrieve review filters and values](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/get-filters-and-values.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/v1/order/{store_id}/{product_id}/orders.json` If you're collecting orders metadata properties, this call can be used to retrieve all possible filter-types, and their corresponding values, for a specific product.

## API reference · Reviews V1 · Questions and Answers (Q&A)

- [About Q&A](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/about-qa.md): Yotpo Social Q&A enables visitors and prospective buyers to get real-time answers from store owners and past buyers.
- [Retrieve Q&A for a product](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/reviews-retrieve-questions-and-answers-for-a-product.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/products/{store_id}/{sku}/questions` Retrieve questions and public answers for a given product using the product SKU number.
- [Retrieve the bottom line for Q&A](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/reviews-retrieve-the-bottom-line-for-questions-and-answers.md): `GET https://api.yotpo.com/products/{store_id}/{sku}/qna_bottomline` Retrieve the Bottom Line for a given product using the product SKU number. The Bottom Line will return the total questions and total answers for the desired product.
- [Retrieve answered questions for a product](https://docs.yotpo.com/reference/retrieve-product-questions-storefront.md): `GET https://api-cdn.yotpo.com/v1/widget/{store_id}/products/{product_id}/questions` Returns a product's questions that have at least one published answer, newest first, with their answers and vote counts. This is what the V3 Q&A widget shows. No access token is needed.
